title: fix(client): let non-Payment 402 challenges fall through to other protocols
quote: Fixes #1113. A 402 whose WWW-Authenticate has no Payment challenge (for example WWW-Authenticate: X402) made the MPP protocol throw No Payment schemes found. while collecting challenges, so x402 never got the response. The MPP protocol now returns no challenges when the header holds no Payment scheme (Challenge.hasPaymentScheme, internal, reusing the quote-aware scheme scanner). Malformed Payment challenges still throw.

title: wevm/mppx mppx@0.17.0 release notes
quote: Fixed the client throwing No Payment schemes found. on a 402 whose WWW-Authenticate has no Payment challenge, so other protocols such as x402 now handle it.

title: fix(mpp): pass through non-session payment responses
fix(core): reject non-object JSON payment headers
quote: decodePaymentSignatureHeader, decodePaymentRequiredHeader, and decodePaymentResponseHeader in typescript/packages/core/src/http/index.ts cast JSON.parse to a payment type. null, arrays, strings, numbers, and booleans came back as typed payment data. Those decoders now throw when the decoded JSON is not an object... Port of x402-foundation/x402#3917 from Python HTTP to TypeScript SDK.

title: TypeScript core payment-header decoders accept non-object JSON
feat: Python and TypeScript conformance to 813 vectors
quote: Brings the Python and TypeScript SDKs to full offline conformance (813 vectors). Python 813/813 pass, 0 known_failing, 0 unsupported. TypeScript 813/813 pass, 0 known_failing, 0 unsupported. Python and TypeScript now build version-1 charge and x402 transactions. The Go, PHP and Ruby verifiers cant decode version 1 yet, so the 24 new cross cells where they verify those builds are tracked as known_failing.
